verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public GitHub repository for Braintrust's JavaScript SDK (braintrustdata/braintrust-sdk-javascript), so some client-side source is readable. The core platform appears closed: even the self-hosted option keeps the UI, authentication and platform management with Braintrust, and no license terms are shown anywhere. missing for 10: evidence of an open-source license, source availability for the core platform/server and UI, and coverage beyond the JS SDK client library.
